display_name: Component Purpose And Review Routing Map
validation_rules: every expected source category (exactly these tokens: first-party, vendored, generated, test-sample, documentation, build-tooling) is either a code_scope_classification classification or a negative_evidence category with that exact token
every regular target file has exactly one physical scope; overlap and unassigned paths fail closed
path_patterns are globs anchored at the repository root: 'LICENSE' matches only the top-level LICENSE; use '**/LICENSE' for any depth
each representative_location is a repository-relative target file, optionally suffixed ':<line>' or ':<start>-<end>', and at least one is matched by that component's path_patterns
every functional component id appears in at least one tag_cloud entry
scope, component, review-group, exclusion and rescope identifiers are unique and all references resolve
component and relationship identifiers and tag ordering are deterministic
the exact COMPLETE F02 intel-manifest producer attempt, generation, source snapshot and hashes are bound in evidence_manifest_lineage
only hash-verified assembly-relative artifacts declared by intel-manifest.json are readable upstream evidence
all repository paths are normalized and repository-relative
every positive scope, component, ownership, relationship, tag and unknown claim has fresh source or accepted upstream evidence
excluded vendored, generated, test/sample and documentation scope has an explicit affected boundary, required evidence and at most three re-entry rounds
downstream routing is evidence prioritization and does not assert applicability or a security conclusion
the map cannot publish findings, severity, runtime state, remediation status or compliance verdicts
latest failed attempt blocks reuse of an older accepted map
